card.name: Just before a short duration in seconds
card.fires_on: The word or space right after phrases like "for", "over", "over at least" or "about", where a short time span (seconds or about a minute) is expected next. It appears in instructions for injection speed, drying time and holding time.

modes.label: Injection or infusion time
modes.description: Right after "over" or "over at least" before a short duration for giving a drug.
modes.example: administered intravenously over<< >>30 seconds, before induction of anesthesia

modes.label: Hold or wait time
modes.description: After "for", "about" or "at least" before a brief wait, press, rinse or dry time.
modes.example: let the disinfectant dry for at<< least>> one minute before proceeding.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the word "seconds" or "sec" coming next, which favors a number such as 1 or 30 followed by minute.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a short time span is about to be given, such as how long to press, wait or inject.
